items.title: Closed windows give their memory back
items.text: Closing a window frees everything in it again — about 100 MB per window, which since v1.44.0 stayed in use until you quit.

items.title: Closing a pane ends what it was running
items.text: A closed split's shell or session now exits once the close can no longer be undone (5 seconds by default, set by undo-timeout), instead of lingering until the window's layout changed again.

items.title: Hidden windows use less memory
items.text: A window that's covered, minimized, or on another Space drops its spare rendering buffers and picks up where it left off when you come back.

items.title: Fewer things left running
items.text: Pane animations and failed viewer opens no longer keep running after the pane is gone.
